>Explanation: 

 

Among the major Clostridium species, Clostridium perfringens is non-motile, which helps distinguish it from other Clostridia that are motile due to peritrichous flagella.

 

Other options: 

 

Option B. Cl. Novyi: motile by peritrichous flagella.

 

Option C. Cl. Botulinum: motile by peritrichous flagella.

 

Option D. Cl. Difficile: motile by peritrichous flagella.

 

TAKE HOME POINT:

 

Cl. perfringens is the only nonmotile major pathogenic Clostridium. All others (C. botulinum, C. difficile, C. novyi) are motile with peritrichous flagella.

questions.stem: Swarming growth on culture is characteristic of which Gram-positive organism:
questions.solutionHtml:
rong>Explanation:

 

Swarming growth refers to rapid, coordinated movement of a bacterial population across a solid surface, typically seen on blood agar.While Proteus mirabilis (a Gram-negative bacterium) is the most classic example of swarming growth, among Gram-positive organisms, Clostridium tetani is also known for producing swarming growth with a spreading film on anaerobic media.

 

 

Other options: 

 

Option A. Clostridium welchii: also known as clostridium perfringes , it is the only non-motile organism among the clostridium species 

 

Option B. Clostridium difficile : it is motile by peritrichous flagella but doesn’t show swarming growth. 

 

Option C. Bacillus cereus: it is motile but doesn’t swarm. 

 

Educational Objective: 

 

Swarming growth involves coordinated bacterial movement across surfaces; Proteus mirabilis is the classic example, though some Clostridium species can also exhibit this spreading pattern.

questions.solutionHtml:

Explanation:

 

Anthrax toxin is produced by Bacillus anthracis. It has three fractions: Protective Antigen (PA), Edema Factor (EF), Lethal Factor (LF) and causes the increase in cAMP which is modulated by the edema factor, leading to fluid secretion and edema. The anthrax toxin is plasmid coded (pX01). Anthrax toxin though increases the cAMP but it does not inhibit protein synthesis.

 

Other options:

 

Option A. Has three fractions: this is true. It has three fractions: Protective Antigen (PA), Edema Factor (EF), Lethal Factor.

 

Option B. Increase cAMP, this is true. It increases in cAMP which is modulated by the edema factor , leading to fluid secretion and edema.

 

Option C. Coded by plasmid: this is true, The anthrax toxin is plasmid coded (pX01).

 

Educational Objective:

 

Anthrax toxin is a three-component, plasmid-encoded toxin that causes pathology through cAMP elevation and edema formation, not protein synthesis inhibition.

questions.stem: Which one of the following species of Clostridium does not break carbohydrate and protein:
questions.solutionHtml:
>

 

Explanation: 

 

Among the species of Clostridium, most are known to break down carbohydrates and proteins due to their fermentative and proteolytic abilities except C. Cochlearum which is non-saccharolytic and non- proteolytic. It does not ferment carbohydrates or break down proteins.

Other options: 

 

Option A. Sporogenes: is Strongly proteolytic, that is it breaks down proteins and changes the colour of the meat particles in Robertson coocked meat broth into black.

 

Option B. Septicum: Both proteolytic and saccharolytic.

 

Option D. Novyi: it is proteolytic and shows toxin production and fermentative activity.

 

Educational Objective:

 

C. cochlearum is the only Clostridium that is both non-saccharolytic and non-proteolytic (can't break carbohydrates or proteins),All other Clostridium species (sporogenes, septicum, novyi) are metabolically active and break down carbs and/or proteins.
